content: आङ्गिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [अङ्ग निर्वृत्तार्थे-ठक्] .²1 Bodily, corporeal. .²2 Gesticulated, expressed by bodily actions; आङ्गिकोऽभिनयः, see अभिनय. .{@-कः@} .²1 A player on a tabor or drum. .²2 Manʼs sleeved outer body, garment, a coat reaching below the knees. कश्मीरजपृषद्वर्षरञ्जितेनाङ्गिकेन च <ls>Śiva B. 21. 19</ls>.
